unit.title: Dropping by briefly
canDo: Arrange a brief visit with a condition and an exit
Read vague short-wait expressions without inventing minutes
Use 喂 for opening a telephone call

grammar.pattern: 的话 / 等：条件与列举
grammar.purpose: Read the whole phrase instead of its literal pieces
grammar.explanation: 有空的话 introduces a condition, not somebody’s spoken words. 药片、药水等 is a non-exhaustive list, not an instruction to wait. Compare 等一会儿, the waiting verb in another context. Neither an open list nor a condition provides missing doses, dates or permission.

examples.zh: 方便的话，我来坐一会儿。
examples.py: fāng biàn de huà , wǒ lái zuò yī huì er .
examples.en: If convenient, I will come and sit a while.

examples.py: yào piàn , yào shuǐ děng dōu xiān fàng hǎo .
examples.en: Put the tablets, liquid medicine and so on properly in place first.

examples.zh: 等一会儿，再问她方便不方便。
examples.py: děng yī huì er , zài wèn tā fāng biàn bù fāng biàn .
examples.en: Wait a while, then ask whether it is convenient for her.

commonMistakes.wrong: 有空的话，所以我一定来。意思是还要看方便不方便。
commonMistakes.why: Keep the visit conditional instead of asserting certain arrival.

grammar.pattern: 不一会儿：短时间后的变化
grammar.explanation: 不一会儿电话响了 describes a short interval before a change. It does not mean an exact five minutes. 坐一会儿 states a short duration of sitting; 不一会儿…了 introduces what happens afterward. If the visit needs an exact end time, ask and state it separately.

examples.py: bù yī huì er , tā huí le xiāo xī .
examples.en: A little later, she replied to the message.

examples.py: wǒ zuò yī huì er jiù zǒu .
examples.en: I will sit a short while and then leave.

examples.zh: 五点离开，这是确认的时间。
examples.py: wǔ diǎn lí kāi , zhè shì què rèn de shí jiān .
examples.en: Leave at five; that is the confirmed time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不一会儿一定就是五分钟。
commonMistakes.right: 不一会儿说的是短时间，不是准确分钟。
commonMistakes.why: The expression itself does not supply an exact duration.

grammar.purpose: Open a telephone call and identify yourself
grammar.explanation: 喂，你好，我是… can open a call. Use the stated greeting and identify yourself, then ask whether speaking is convenient. Do not read it as 喂动物 feed animals, another full-tone reading and meaning. A greeting is not consent to a long call; allow the listener to decline.

examples.py: wèi , nǐ hǎo , wǒ shì xiǎo wáng .
xiàn zài fāng biàn shuō huà ma ?
examples.en: Is it convenient to talk now?

examples.zh: 不方便的话，我晚点儿再联系。
examples.py: bù fāng biàn de huà , wǒ wǎn diǎn ér zài lián xì .
examples.en: If inconvenient, I will contact you later.

commonMistakes.why: The greeting should not become a demand for an uninterrupted call.

dialogue.title: Five means the exit time
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the condition, agreed end time and optional visit.

lines.zh: 喂，你好，我是小王。现在方便吗？
lines.py: wèi , nǐ hǎo , wǒ shì xiǎo wáng . xiàn zài fāng biàn ma ?
lines.en: Hello, this is Xiao Wang. Is now convenient?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以说一小会儿。我已经出院，在家休息。
lines.py: kě yǐ shuō yī xiǎo huì ér . wǒ yǐ jīng chū yuàn , zài jiā xiū xī .
lines.en: We can talk briefly. I have been discharged and am resting at home.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 方便的话，我来坐一会儿？
lines.py: fāng biàn de huà , wǒ lái zuò yī huì er ?
lines.en: If convenient, may I visit briefly?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 今天可以，四点半来，五点走。
lines.py: jīn tiān kě yǐ , sì diǎn bàn lái , wǔ diǎn zǒu .
lines.en: Today is fine: come at half past four and leave at five.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。不一会儿你回消息，是五分钟的意思吗？
lines.py: hǎo . bù yī huì er nǐ huí xiāo xī , shì wǔ fēn zhōng de yì si ma ?
lines.en: Okay. When you say you replied shortly afterward, does that mean five minutes?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是准确分钟。今天五点走才是定好的时间。
lines.py: bù shì zhǔn què fēn zhōng . jīn tiān wǔ diǎn zǒu cái shì dìng hǎo de shí jiān .
lines.en: It is not an exact number of minutes. Leaving at five today is the agreed time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 需要我带药片、药水等吗？
lines.py: xū yào wǒ dài yào piàn , yào shuǐ děng ma ?
lines.en: Do you need me to bring tablets, liquid medicine or things like that?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不用，不要替我安排用药。来问候就好。
lines.py: bù yòng , bú yào tì wǒ ān pái yòng yào . lái wèn hòu jiù hǎo .
lines.en: No; do not arrange medication for me. A greeting visit is enough.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Today from 4:30 to 5, with no medication arrangement
Five minutes after an invented reply
questions.answer: Today from 4:30 to 5, with no medication arrangement

reading.title: A considerate short visit
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read the actual boundary and information that remains unstated.

lines.zh: 朋友以前住院，已经出院，今天在家休养。
lines.py: péng you yǐ qián zhù yuàn , yǐ jīng chū yuàn , jīn tiān zài jiā xiū yǎng .
lines.en: My friend was previously hospitalized, has been discharged, and is resting at home today.

lines.zh: 我先打电话，喂，你好，现在方便吗？
lines.py: wǒ xiān dǎ diàn huà , wèi , nǐ hǎo , xiàn zài fāng biàn ma ?
lines.en: I phone first: hello, is now convenient?

lines.zh: 方便的话我再去，不方便就改天。
lines.py: fāng biàn de huà wǒ zài qù , bù fāng biàn jiù gǎi tiān .
lines.en: I will go if convenient; if not, another day.

lines.zh: 她答应今天四点半见，五点结束。
lines.py: tā dā yìng jīn tiān sì diǎn bàn jiàn , wǔ diǎn jié shù .
lines.en: She agrees to meet today at half past four and finish at five.

lines.zh: 不一会儿回消息只说短时间，不给准确分钟。
lines.py: bù yī huì er huí xiāo xī zhǐ shuō duǎn shí jiān , bù gěi zhǔn què fēn zhōng .
lines.en: Replying shortly afterward describes a short interval without exact minutes.

lines.zh: 太阳出来，天上有云，她还是想休息。
lines.py: tài yáng chū lái , tiān shàng yǒu yún , tā hái shi xiǎng xiū xī .
lines.en: The sun is out and clouds are in the sky; she still wants to rest.

lines.zh: 我不问全身哪里疼，也不替她诊断和安排药。
lines.py: wǒ bù wèn quán shēn nǎ lǐ téng , yě bù tì tā zhěn duàn hé ān pái yào .
lines.en: I do not question which parts hurt or diagnose and arrange medication on her behalf.

lines.zh: 她没说预约月份，我们不猜；问候后按时离开。
lines.py: tā méi shuō yù yuē yuè fèn , wǒ men bù cāi ; wèn hòu hòu àn shí lí kāi .
lines.en: She has not given the appointment month, so we do not guess; after greeting her, we leave on time.

choices: Consent, a time limit and respect for privacy
Treating a greeting as unrestricted permission
questions.answer: Consent, a time limit and respect for privacy

extraReadings.title: A short visit, really
extraReadings.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
extraReadings.purpose: Read an original scene about taking a time boundary seriously.

lines.zh: 我只来一会儿，天上的云都还没走。
lines.py: wǒ zhǐ lái yī huì er , tiān shàng de yún dōu hái méi zǒu .
lines.en: I will visit briefly; even the clouds have not gone.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 云没有约定，我有。五点休息。
lines.py: yún méi yǒu yuē dìng , wǒ yǒu . wǔ diǎn xiū xī .
lines.en: The clouds have no agreement; I do. I rest at five.

lines.zh: 好，五点走，不跟月亮一起坐。
lines.py: hǎo , wǔ diǎn zǒu , bù gēn yuè liang yì qǐ zuò .
lines.en: Okay, leave at five; I will not stay sitting with the moon.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢。问候到了，时间也要到。
lines.py: xiè xiè . wèn hòu dào le , shí jiān yě yào dào .
lines.en: Thanks. Your greeting arrived; the end time should too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 晚安，今天不再打扰。
lines.py: wǎn ān , jīn tiān bù zài dǎ rǎo .
lines.en: Good night; no more disturbance today.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，明天有空再聊。
lines.py: hǎo , míng tiān yǒu kōng zài liáo .
lines.en: Okay; talk tomorrow if there is time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她说全身累，想先休息。
lines.py: tā shuō quán shēn lèi , xiǎng xiān xiū xī .
lines.en: She says her whole body feels tired and wants to rest first.

lines.zh: 闻到饭的味道，不等于现在想吃。
lines.py: wén dào fàn de wèi dào , bù děng yú xiàn zài xiǎng chī .
lines.en: Smelling food does not mean wanting to eat now.

lines.zh: 我闻到饭香了，不过还没问吃什么。
lines.py: wǒ wén dào fàn xiāng le , bù guò hái méi wèn chī shén me .
lines.en: I smell food cooking, but have not asked what we will eat.

lines.zh: 她想去院子呼吸空气，但还要问自己方便不方便。
lines.py: tā xiǎng qù yuàn zi hū xī kōng qì , dàn hái yào wèn zì jǐ fāng biàn bù fāng biàn .
lines.en: She wants some air in the courtyard, but still needs to consider whether it is convenient for her.

lines.zh: 屋里空气不好，我们先出去。
lines.py: wū lǐ kōng qì bù hǎo , wǒ men xiān chū qù .
lines.en: The indoor air is unpleasant; let us go outside first.

lines.zh: 书里讲地球，不是今天的天气预报。
lines.py: shū lǐ jiǎng dì qiú , bù shì jīn tiān de tiān qì yù bào .
lines.en: The book discusses Earth, not today’s weather forecast.

lines.zh: 这段话讲地球，不是在讲某个城市。
lines.py: zhè duàn huà jiǎng dì qiú , bù shì zài jiǎng mǒu gè chéng shì .
lines.en: This passage concerns Earth, not a particular city.

lines.zh: 晚上窗外有月亮。
lines.py: wǎn shang chuāng wài yǒu yuè liang .
lines.en: The moon is outside the window at night.

lines.zh: 她喜欢看星星，不一定想出门。
lines.py: tā xǐ huān kàn xīng xing , bù yí dìng xiǎng chū mén .
lines.en: She likes looking at stars but does not necessarily want to go out.

lines.zh: 今天云很多，看不到星星。
lines.py: jīn tiān yún hěn duō , kàn bù dào xīng xing .
lines.en: There are many clouds today; the stars are not visible.

lines.zh: 夜里我们不再打电话。
lines.py: yè lǐ wǒ men bù zài dǎ diàn huà .
lines.en: We do not call again at night.

lines.zh: 一生的习惯不是一晚就能知道。
lines.py: yī shēng de xí guàn bù shì yī wǎn jiù néng zhī dào .
lines.en: A person’s lifelong habits cannot be known in one evening.

lines.zh: 这篇故事写一个人的一生，不只写一天。
lines.py: zhè piān gù shì xiě yī gè rén de yī shēng , bù zhǐ xiě yī tiān .
lines.en: This story describes a person’s lifetime, not just one day.

lines.zh: 永远尊重朋友，也包括让她休息。
lines.py: yǒng yuǎn zūn zhòng péng you , yě bāo kuò ràng tā xiū xī .
lines.en: Always respecting a friend includes letting her rest.

lines.zh: 我不能答应永远不改时间，但改了会告诉你。
lines.py: wǒ bù néng dā yìng yǒng yuǎn bù gǎi shí jiān , dàn gǎi le huì gào sù nǐ .
lines.en: I cannot promise never to change the time, but will tell you if it changes.

audio.en: She has not stated the appointment month.

audio.en: She has been discharged and is resting at home.

line.py: tài yáng chū lái , tā hái xiǎng xiū xī .
line.en: The sun is out and she still wants to rest.

line.zh: 朋友以前【住院】，现在在家。
line.py: péng you yǐ qián zhù yuàn , xiàn zài zài jiā .
line.en: The friend was previously hospitalized and is now at home.

right.en: Although it rains, the time has not changed.

right.en: A book lies on the table; she has not read it yet.

natural.zh: 方便的话，我来坐一会儿？
natural.py: fāng biàn de huà , wǒ lái zuò yī huì er ?
natural.en: May I visit briefly if convenient?

pragmatics.note: Allow refusal; do not assume availability.

natural.py: hǎo , wǔ diǎn wǒ jiù zǒu .
natural.en: Okay, I will leave at five.

pragmatics.note: Use the actual end time rather than vague briefly.

conversation.context: Understand conditional phrasing and short waits.
conversation.goal: Arrange a brief visit with a condition and an exit

notes: AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 二35, 二42, 二36. Health words are comprehension examples; no diagnosis, drug choice or dose is taught. Planned retrieval 二30 / 二65 / 二33 / 二56 / 二70: 虽然下雨，但是时间没变。, 门开着，不等于可以直接进去。, 桌上放着书，她还没有读。.
